summary: Changed fees $47.93-189.11 -> $45.89-89.30 (April low read; $189.11 is two sites). Added 50A, 70-ft max, wifi, dump, year-round with winter limits, KOA Rewards. Note cleaned of rates and RV Life line.
flags: GATE, BORDERLINE: the only type under $50 is 'Back In, 30 Amps, Water/Electric' at $45.89 (Apr 2027) / $47.93 (May, July 2027), which KOA offered to the 23-ft motorhome search but describes: 'Perfect for pop-ups! ... Nestled near a row of trees and away from all the action. You will need to detach tow vehicle and park in parking lot. No 50 amp rigs allowed.' Stored rule counts a class the engine offers to a 23-ft Class C, so I based on it. If those aren't real motorhome sites the next is $54.11 ('Near pond', also 'Must detach tow vehicle'; 'Only 2 sites left!' in May), then $67.31 full hookup back-in and $68.29 pull-thru, which is over $50 with no gateway. November offers only pull-thrus from $63.65. RV Life tier is $$$. GS Park: no (stored false, derived). 10% KOA Rewards is a paid membership. Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Cincinnati 91 km, Indianapolis 111 km). Family has not stayed.

REVIEWS: Google 'Richmond KOA Holiday' 4.6 from 628 reviews; phone 765-962-1219 matches. Newest read warm: 'What a nice KOA. Very clean, well kept, and quiet' (4 months ago). Only recurring gripe is I-70: 'The only downside is being so close to the freeway you can hear it, but it's not terrible' (5 months ago); KOA's page carries a 10/26/2026 line: 'the campground is next to the highway so you can hear all the traffic.'

WATER: stored 'lakeview' is really a pond. KOA sells 'Pond View!' pull-thrus on the row along the north side of a roughly 1.5-acre fishing pond ('Enjoy a view of our beautiful fishing pond from your site'); imagery: that row is about 15-40 m from the shore, with a road between. Re-audit lead; 'lake' overstates it, whichever value is chosen.
PIN: stored 39.8712,-84.86356 is on the north RV row, about 50 m from the park's centre. Fine.
HIGH: stored $189.11 is 'This reservation includes 2 pull through buddy sites'; single-site high is $89.30.
LEAD: discounts.military true is derived from the Good Sam directory; KOA's pages I read don't mention it. Left alone.
